links.outcome: Rate of surgically reasonable fusion levels by Lenke curve subtype
links.effect: Overall 70.9% (144/203) reasonable; varied significantly by Lenke subtype: high for 1A (87.0%), 1B (82.9%), 5C (81.1%), 6C (87.5%), low for 1C (19.0%), 2A (42.9%), 2C (25.0%).
links.quote: Performance varied significantly by Lenke subtype, demonstrating high reasonable rates for types 1A (87.0%), 1B (82.9%), 5C (81.1%), and 6C (87.5%).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of DeepSeek-R1 for surgical planning in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis assessed by spinal surgeons; evaluates model performance without testing specific deployment safeguards.
